title: 超越情感分类：文本情感强度评估的生成框架
summary: 提出一种从离散分类转向连续情感强度评估的新方法。通过构建情感强度数据集并微调生成式语言模型输出0-100的连续值，在金融等领域展现出更强的表达力和泛化能力，优于传统分类基线。
summary_en: Introduces a generative framework for emotion intensity evaluation, shifting from discrete classification to continuous 0-100 scoring. Fine-tuned LLMs outperform classification baselines and show generalization to sentiment and arousal, benefiting domains like finance.
